title: Octane – React's programming model, compiled
summary: Octane is a new framework that brings React's programming model to a compiled approach, allowing developers to use familiar React patterns while benefiting from compiled output for better performance. The framework maintains React's mental model but transforms the code through compilation rather than relying on runtime interpretation.
problem_solved: Provides React's developer-friendly programming model with compiled performance optimizations
why_valuable: Combines the productivity of React's API with the performance advantages of ahead-of-time compilation
